evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall be available as a mobile application for both Android and iOS devices.
The system shall fully load and be ready for user interaction within a maximum of two seconds after startup.
The system shall display current football news relevant to the user's selected favorite teams.

issues.explanation: 'Relevant' is a subjective and ambiguous term that may have multiple interpretations and is not objectively measurable.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display current football news for the user's selected favorite teams.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to individually select preferred sports news channels for display.
The system shall provide a live ticker module that displays real-time results for the user's favorite teams.

issues.explanation: 'Real-time' is a vague term unless a specific time threshold (e.g., within x seconds) is defined. It lacks clear testability.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide a live ticker module that displays results for the user's favorite teams within five seconds of real-world events.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide coverage of all national and international football leagues and competitions.

issues.detected_issue: all national and international football leagues and competitions
issues.explanation: 'All' is not specific or verifiable and 'national and international football leagues and competitions' may be interpreted differently by stakeholders.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide coverage of the football leagues and competitions specified in Appendix A.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display detailed team and player information on demand.

issues.explanation: 'Detailed' is subjective and open to interpretation. The requirement should specify what information must be included to be testable.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team and player information, including statistics, profiles, and recent match history, on demand.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall integrate live stream links from external providers (e.g., DAZN, Sky Sport) and display them when a live broadcast has begun.

issues.explanation: This statement merges two separate requirements: integration and display. Each should be defined individually.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall integrate live stream links from external providers (e.g., DAZN, Sky Sport). The system shall display integrated live stream links when a live broadcast has begun.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall ensure that live stream links are only displayed when transmission rights are fulfilled for the user's country.

issues.explanation: 'Fulfilled' is ambiguous – the requirement should detail the verification mechanism for rights and conditions for display.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display live stream links to users only if the corresponding transmission rights for the user's country have been validated.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall retrieve live ticker data via an API from an external server.
The system shall update live ticker data in the user interface within a few seconds of real-world events.

issues.explanation: 'A few seconds' is an ambiguous and non-quantifiable time frame. A specific value is required for testability.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall update live ticker data in the user interface within five seconds of real-world events.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a user interface that allows direct access to all app modules and information.

issues.explanation: 'All' is unbounded and ambiguous. A list or specific enumeration is required for clarity.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide a user interface that allows direct access to the modules and information listed in Appendix B.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to customize the user interface theme (e.g., light/dark mode or color schemes).
The system shall provide a notification system that informs users about current events when notifications are enabled.

issues.explanation: 'Current events' is vague and can be interpreted differently. Specify what types of events trigger notifications.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide a notification system that informs users about match results and news updates when notifications are enabled.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require all users to register and log in before accessing any app features.
The system shall allow users to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs.

issues.explanation: 'Personalize their experience' is subjective and not directly testable. The concrete behavior is 'following favorite clubs.'
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to follow favorite clubs.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to receive notifications about news or results related to their favorite teams.
The system shall allow users to share news articles and game reports via social media directly from the app.
The system shall function reliably with limited network coverage, allowing access to previously loaded content and basic navigation when offline.

issues.explanation: 'Reliably' is subjective. Requirement must state measurable system behavior under specific network conditions.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to access previously loaded content and use basic navigation features when network coverage is unavailable.

issues.detected_issue: allowing access to previously loaded content and basic navigation
issues.explanation: This requirement expresses two distinct behaviors (content access, basic navigation). Each should be defined separately.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to access previously loaded content when offline. The system shall allow basic navigation when offline.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require an active internet connection for live data and live stream features.
The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation.

issues.explanation: 'Performance degradation' is ambiguous. Define measurable criteria such as maximum response time or throughput.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users with a maximum average response time of 2 seconds.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions.

issues.explanation: 'Thorough' is vague. Define what tests must be performed and acceptance criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall undergo unit, integration, and system acceptance tests before release to detect and resolve malfunctions.

issues.explanation: Testing and support are two distinct processes and should each be described in their own requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall undergo defined testing processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions. The system shall have support processes established before release.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.

issues.explanation: Improvement is subjective and non-testable. The requirement must state how to evaluate and the expected outcome.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record and summarize user feedback and app reviews weekly, and present the results to product management for review.

issues.detected_issue: evaluate user feedback and app reviews
issues.explanation: Evaluating user feedback and app reviews are different processes and should be specified separately.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record and summarize user feedback weekly. The system shall record and summarize app reviews weekly.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process all personal user data in compliance with the GDPR.

issues.explanation: 'Compliance' is broad and non-testable unless compliance criteria are referenced or detailed.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall process personal user data according to GDPR requirements detailed in Appendix C.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall be fully loaded and ready for user interaction within two seconds of app launch on supported Android and iOS devices under typical network conditions.
The system shall support at least 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation, including during peak match days.

issues.explanation: 'Performance degradation' lacks measurable criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support at least 100,000 concurrent users with an average response time under two seconds, including during peak match days.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall update and display live ticker data within five seconds of real-world events as provided by the external API.

issues.explanation: Updating and displaying are distinct actions and should be described in separate requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall update live ticker data within five seconds of real-world events as provided by the external API. The system shall display updated live ticker data immediately upon update.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded news, team, and player information, and allow basic navigation when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.detected_issue: provide offline access ... and allow basic navigation
issues.explanation: Providing offline access and allowing basic navigation are two functions. Each should be a separate requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded news, team, and player information when network connectivity is unavailable. The system shall allow basic navigation when network connectivity is unavailable.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall ensure that live stream links are only displayed to users in countries where the respective transmission rights are fulfilled.

issues.explanation: 'Fulfilled' is ambiguous.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display live stream links only to users in countries where the required transmission rights have been validated.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process all personal user data in full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), including user consent, data minimization, and right to erasure.

issues.detected_issue: full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
issues.explanation: 'Full compliance' is too general; detail compliance requirements by reference.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall process all personal user data in accordance with GDPR requirements described in Appendix D, including handling of user consent, data minimization, and right to erasure.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require all users to register and log in before accessing any app features.
The system shall allow users to select and apply at least two UI themes (e.g., light and dark mode) for personalization.
The system shall maintain consistent user interface layout and module availability regardless of external server updates.

issues.detected_issue: consistent user interface layout and module availability
issues.explanation: 'Consistent' is subjective; specify required UI elements or layout stability criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall maintain the user interface layout and the availability of specified modules as defined in Appendix E, regardless of external server updates.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall undergo comprehensive testing and support processes prior to release to detect and resolve malfunctions, with user feedback and app reviews continuously evaluated post-release for improvements.

issues.explanation: Comprehensive is vague and support processes should be defined. Multiple requirements are present.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall undergo unit, integration, and acceptance testing prior to release to detect and resolve malfunctions. The system shall review and summarize user feedback and app reviews weekly after release.

issues.detected_issue: testing and support processes ... user feedback and app reviews continuously evaluated
issues.explanation: This statement encompasses several requirements (testing, support, evaluation of feedback/reviews). Each should be specified independently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall undergo formal testing prior to release. The system shall establish support processes prior to release. The system shall evaluate user feedback and app reviews for improvements after release.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall ensure that registration and login processes can be completed within ten seconds under typical network conditions.
The system shall provide notifications to users within five seconds of relevant events when the notification function is activated.

issues.explanation: 'Relevant events' is vague and open to interpretation. Specify the criteria for events that trigger notifications.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide notifications to users within five seconds of a goal, red card, or match result when the notification function is activated.
